Failure Mode: Unclear what 'reliable' means; no shared language between product & eng
Mitigation: Define SLIs (latency, availability, freshness) + SLO targets + error budget policy
Do: Page on user-impacting SLO burn (multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts); halt risky launches when budget spent
Don't: Page on raw thresholds; chase 100% availability
Keywords: slo sli sla error budget burn rate
Notes: See Google SRE Book Ch.4. Use Sloth/Pyrra to generate burn-rate alerts from YAML.

Mitigation: Client + server timeouts at every hop; keep them shorter than upstream
Do: Set deadlines that propagate (context.Context / gRPC deadline)
Don't: Rely on TCP keepalive; use 'no timeout'
Notes: Always set 3 timeouts: connect, read, total. Propagate via Context/Deadline.

Failure Mode: Naive retries cause thundering herd; non-idempotent retries cause duplicates
Mitigation: Exponential backoff + jitter; cap attempts; total retry budget per call
Do: Retry only idempotent calls; carry idempotency keys
Notes: See AWS Builders' Library 'Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter'.

Failure Mode: Failing dependency cascades and exhausts caller threads
Mitigation: State machine (closed/open/half-open) trips on error rate
Do: Trip on % error in window; expose state metric; manual override
Notes: Combine with bulkhead so one bad dep can't drown others.

Failure Mode: One slow dep starves a shared pool
Do: Size pools per dep based on max concurrent calls
Don't: Share one HTTP client pool across all backends
Notes: Especially important in multi-tenant SaaS gateways.

Mitigation: Server stores idempotency key + response; replay on duplicate
Do: Use Stripe-style 'Idempotency-Key' header for all unsafe HTTP methods
Notes: See Stripe API doc; TTL keys 24h–30d depending on flow.

Failure Mode: In-flight requests killed; queues left in inconsistent state
Mitigation: Drain LB; stop accepting; finish in-flight; close clients
Do: Trap SIGTERM, set readiness false, wait for in-flight, then exit
Metric: Shutdown duration, requests dropped on rollout
Notes: K8s preStop hook + 'terminationGracePeriodSeconds' tuned to your worst-case in-flight.

Failure Mode: Crash-loop or stuck pod takes traffic
Mitigation: Cheap liveness (process alive); deeper readiness (deps OK)
Do: Readiness must check critical deps; liveness must NOT (avoid crash-loop on dep blip)
Don't: Use the same probe for both
Notes: Add a 'startupProbe' for slow-starting JVM apps to avoid liveness false positives.

Mitigation: Plan to ≤60-70% of capacity at peak; load test 2× projection
Do: Run quarterly load tests; track headroom %

Failure Mode: Region/AZ outage with no rehearsed recovery
Mitigation: Define RPO/RTO; backups + restores tested quarterly; failover runbooks
Metric: RPO, RTO, backup success rate, restore-time SLA
Keywords: rpo rto disaster recovery game day
Notes: Untested backups = no backups. Run quarterly restore drills.

Failure Mode: Single AZ/region outage takes the system down
Mitigation: Stateless across AZs; multi-AZ datastore; multi-region for tier-1
Do: Multi-AZ by default; multi-region only when SLA / latency / residency requires
Notes: Use cell-based architecture to bound blast radius without going multi-region.

Failure Mode: Data corruption / accidental delete with no point-in-time
Do: RDS PITR, S3 versioning + Object Lock, immutable backups
Don't: Trust managed snapshots without testing restore
Keywords: backup pitr wal s3 object lock
Notes: Use S3 Object Lock to prevent ransomware-style backup deletion.

Mitigation: Deliberate failure injection in staging then prod GameDays
Do: Inject latency / faults / pod kills / AZ failovers; observe & document
Don't: Chaos in prod without observability + SLOs
Keywords: chaos engineering litmus chaos mesh fis
Notes: Start with single-pod kills; graduate to dependency latency injection.

Failure Mode: Same incidents handled differently; long MTTR
Mitigation: Per-alert runbook URL; periodic blameless review
Do: Link runbook URL in every alert; rotate runbook ownership
Notes: Use blameless postmortems; track action-item completion rate.

Mitigation: Roll out gradually; auto-abort on metric regression
Do: Use Argo Rollouts / Flagger / Spinnaker; abort on SLO burn
Keywords: blue green canary argo rollouts flagger
Notes: Combine canary with feature flags for fast off-switch.

Do: Use LaunchDarkly/Unleash/OpenFeature; clean up stale flags
Notes: Set a 'sunset date' on every flag; track flag debt as a quality metric.

Failure Mode: One tenant abuses shared resources, degrades others
Do: Surface quota errors with retry-after; document limits
Notes: Token bucket per tenant + global; expose remaining quota in headers.

Mitigation: Blameless postmortems with action items tracked to closure
Do: Time-bound action items; share postmortems org-wide
Notes: Include 'how we detected', 'what we tried', 'timeline', 'action items'.
